Special requests

Families

We offer practical services for families from booking to landing to ensure you and your children enjoy a more relaxed flight.

All about flying with children

Pets

Find all the important information about registration and the various carriage options for your pets.

Travelling with animals

Unaccompanied children

Children travelling alone with SWISS are supervised and kept safe at all times, both at the airport and on board. Find out more about our services here.

Go to services for unaccompanied children

Special meals

Choose from our extensive range of vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free or lactose-free meals, or meals for members of certain religions.

Go to special meals

Accessible travel

We assist passengers with disabilities at the airport and during the flight. Take care of the main preparations so that we can eliminate any obstacles for you.

More about accessible travel

Health and travel

A long flight is physically demanding. You must always ensure that you have your fitness to fly checked if you have any health issues. Healthy passengers can enhance their wellbeing with a few tricks.

All you need to know about healthy travel
